Also revised some exception and attempted to fix them, please @rzikm check if I'm inline with your `QuicException` intentions.

Fixes #72238

what would happen if somebody runs with older msquic?

> what would happen if somebody runs with older msquic?

It obviously won't work properly, both flags will be 0 (since they were part of `RESERVED` field and the exception will wrongly be `ConnectionIdle`.

But I do assume we're gonna release a new version of msquic for .NET 7.0, publish it before GA and check for that version in `MsQuicApi`.
